market_access.label: Market Access
market_access.description: Unlocks Markets so stocked goods can be sold for gold.

mining.label: Mining
mining.description: Unlocks Iron Mines for the first ore production chain.

woodworking.label: Woodworking
woodworking.description: Unlocks Sawmills so wood can be processed into planks.

smelting.label: Smelting
smelting.description: Unlocks Forges for turning ore and fuel into metal bars.

coal_processing.label: Coal Processing
coal_processing.description: Unlocks Coal Mines for hotter, stronger metal production.

blacksmithing.label: Blacksmithing
blacksmithing.description: Unlocks Blacksmiths for finished goods and stronger trade value.

knowledge_production.label: Knowledge Production
knowledge_production.description: Unlocks Schools so the kingdom can turn wealth into knowledge.

basic_accounting.label: Basic Accounting
basic_accounting.description: Markets need 2 fewer work clicks to complete a sale.

lumber_management.label: Lumber Management
lumber_management.description: Unlocks one Manager slot for Lumber Camps.

market_management.label: Market Management
market_management.description: Unlocks one Manager slot for Markets.

grid_expansion.label: Grid Expansion
grid_expansion.description: Adds 16 columns and 8 rows to the build grid.

storage_bins.label: Storage Bins
storage_bins.description: Adds 5 storage capacity to every resource slot.

workshop_tuning.label: Workshop Tuning
workshop_tuning.description: Crafters need 2 fewer work clicks per action.

market_bargaining.label: Market Bargaining
market_bargaining.description: Markets earn 25% more gold from every sale.
